Sexual harassment

39. Sexual harassment remains a problem for women both in and outside work. It is defined in
the Equality Act (EqA) 2010 as “unwanted conduct that has the purpose or effect of violating
a person’s dignity or creating an intimidating, hostile, degrading, humiliating or offensive
environment”. It covers any form of unwanted verbal, non-verbal or physical conduct of a
sexual nature and any less favourable treatment on the ground that the person had rejected
or submitted to unwanted conduct.
